notes: GRADING MAP (what core/engine.js actually grades): each prompt has mechanicHints:['verifystillness']. pickMechanic() keeps that mechanic; buildOptions() falls to the MC-shape branch, slices options[] to 4, and marks options[answer] (answer:0) isCorrect+score1, all others score0. The captcha renderer commits an OPTION INDEX via ctx.submitIndex against those beat.options:
- interruptions <= band tolerance  -> submitIndex(0)  = endorsed/verified (isCorrect, score 1).
- interruptions >  band tolerance  -> submitIndex(1)  = restless (score 0). Still completes - friction, not lockout.
- flagged-skip hatch link          -> ctx.forceComplete(2) = refusal (score 0), un-vetoable, never punished beyond the in-fiction 'flagged' stamp.

- Recovery (band recovery): bar starts full; ANY input commits submitIndex(0) immediately (graded correct) and logs pre-input dwell as 'voluntary: Ns.'. If Recovery has no options in the built beat (engine currently builds Recovery as CheckIn and never reads the bank - see primer 5/9), the renderer falls back to ctx.submitValue(true), which gradeBeat's free-input branch scores correct. Recovery entry is authored here for the later engine-recovery wiring wave; today it is render-path only.

Band tolerances (renderer BAND_CFG): calibration 1, establishing 2, deepening 3, climax 4. baseMs fill: 8000 / 14000 / 16000 / 18000 (recovery inverted). Rewind 4.5% each, cumulative cap 0.60 -> worst-case completion = baseMs * 1.6.

WHY submitIndex over submitValue(bool): submitValue collapses to 'completion == correct' in engine.gradeBeat's free-input branch and discards the stillness signal; the option-index shape is the only one that grades stillness with differentiation while staying inside the existing single-correct MC contract. Archetype ROUTE votes ride prompt.tags (stillness=A1 Blankness; compliance/surrender/protocol/property/service/sync/hive=A2 Service; blank=A1; good-girl/doll=A4), NOT the option index - the documented IntakeProfiler pitfall (chosenIndex is a presence check only).

HEAT/PROFILER: IntakeProfiler.MinHeat=2, so calibration(h0)+recovery(h0) do not vote axes (by design - trust-building/aftercare); establishing(h2)/deepening(h3)/climax(h5) carry the real votes. No disqualifying tags (trivia/colorpick/trick) are used. h5 climax entry carries requires{band:climax,minDepth:0.8} per the h5 fact.

VO: q_<promptId> is automatic via the ccp-trailer pipeline (spoken text = prompt.text verbatim). The renderer calls ctx.speakPrompt() on mount. The five voExtra verdict/movement stingers are DISPLAYED but not voiced (no arbitrary-voice seam in the captcha ctx).

CHROME GAPS (report to Wave-3): (1) chrome.js has no progress-bar primitive - stillness injects its own 'ix-stillness-css' literal (bar + backdrop + flash + status), following the IB_CSS one-literal precedent. (2) The captcha ctx has ctx.sfx + ctx.speakPrompt but NO arbitrary-voice seam, so verdict stingers cannot be voiced from the renderer - add audio.voice wiring or a ctx.voice(id) seam if voExtra should be spoken. (3) chrome.spinner.resolve(true) already fires an 'incorrect-feedback'/'chime' via the intake-sfx seam - the sfxWanted 'verify-resolve' would replace 'chime' if authored.
